# synthetic fixture: format modeled on cobra "Available Commands:" output.
Manage ZITADEL

Usage:
  zitadel [command]

Available Commands:
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help        Help about any command
  init        initialize ZITADEL instance
  keys        manage encryption keys
  mirror      mirrors all data of ZITADEL from one database to another
  ready       Checks if zitadel is ready
  server      Start ZITADEL server
  setup       Setup ZITADEL instance
  start       Start ZITADEL
  version     Print the version

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for zitadel

Use "zitadel [command] --help" for more information about a command.
